verdict.rationale: Signifyd documents a create-webhook API endpoint for registering webhooks programmatically. It also documents outbound webhook notifications sent to the merchant's store whenever a guarantee decision is made, giving a programmatic consumer real-time event delivery. missing for 10: documentation of the full set of subscribable event types beyond guarantee decisions, payload signing/verification and retry semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Create a new webhook. This will add to the list of any existing webhooks.
Signifyd can send a webhook to notify your online store every time a guarantee decision is made on a submitted order. This provides you with real-time updates
